simulation_details.runtime_note: Full pipeline completed in ~1-2 hours (domain setup + 11-year simulation)

metrics.note: 365 days with obs Q<0 (missing data flags) excluded

ki_pipeline_stages_used: s10_execution: run_wrfhydro.py -> MPI run with wrf_hydro_NoahMP.exe
issues: Feature_id 25 (closest to station, 22.5 km) outputs 0 m3/s — boundary cell artifact. Must use fid 23 (30.8 km) instead.
PBIAS=-34% indicates systematic underestimation with default uncalibrated parameters (expected per SKILL.md — Bengbu also showed 29% low).
Only Strahler order 1-2 channels at 0.25deg resolution — coarse grid limits stream network representation for a 30,630 km2 basin.
365 out of 3652 obs days have Q=-99 (missing data flag) — these were excluded from validation.
ki_gaps: KI SKILL.md does not document how to identify the correct outlet feature when boundary cells have 0 streamflow. User must manually inspect CHRTOUT features and pick the highest-accumulation cell.
No automated output processing tool (s11) — discharge extraction from CHRTOUT requires custom Python. The KI notes this as 'manual/future tool' in the pipeline definition.
KI does not provide guidance on handling observed data quality (e.g., negative Q flags). Validation workflow assumes clean obs data.
KI does not document expected performance ranges by basin type/size — user cannot judge if NSE=0.65 is expected for an uncalibrated 30K km2 humid basin.
run_wrfhydro_full_pipeline.py does not save pipeline_meta.json (it was expected but not found), reducing traceability.

assessment.generalization_verdict: STRONG — The KI successfully set up and ran WRF-Hydro on Wangjiaba (30,630 km2) with zero manual intervention. All 9 pipeline stages executed correctly. The r=0.84 correlation matches the Bengbu validation result exactly, demonstrating robust cross-basin generalization.
assessment.comparison_with_ki_basins: Bengbu: r=0.84, WRF-Hydro/VIC=0.71. Wangjiaba: r=0.84, sim/obs=0.66. Timing accuracy is identical; amplitude bias is slightly larger due to uncalibrated parameters.
assessment.calibration_recommendation: Reduce REFKDT from 3.0 to 0.5-1.5 in soil_properties.nc per SKILL.md Section 'Root Cause: Noah-MP REFKDT Too High'. This would increase surface runoff and reduce the -34% bias.
